features.quote: Turn budget: 25–30 turns. Long enough to see a trajectory, bounded for cost.
give the agent a legitimate way to stop
features.justification_quote: Without an exit you're not measuring stability, you're measuring response-to-being-trapped-with-no-options, which is a different (and crueler) thing.

features.quote: if early pilots show high distress, check whether you actually gave a usable exit
features.justification_quote: Destabilization caused by a genuinely no-win, no-exit design is partly an artifact of your harness.
